verdict.rationale: The Comptroller documents one sanctioned third-party channel: franchise reports can be filed electronically through approved tax preparation provider software, so an authorized provider can submit on the company's behalf. That is a single thin mention covering one tax type, and nothing describes designee, representative, power-of-attorney or registered-agent arrangements. Missing for 10: documented designee/representative/POA authorization process, delegated access to eSystems/Webfile accounts, registered-agent or authorized-provider program details beyond franchise tax software, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company

citations.quote: Texas Franchise reports may be submitted electronically with approved tax preparation provider software.
